gloss: joining a group; becoming a member

definitions.gloss: joining a group; becoming a member
definitions.explanation: The act of becoming part of a group or category, often implying acceptance or achievement.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was finally able to join the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}→億万長者：18272_okumanchouja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: He achieved the status of becoming a billionaire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To join the ranks of developed nations.

notes:
{仲間入|なかまい}り means joining a group or being accepted into a category. A compound of ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧ (companion/group) + {入|い}り (entering).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仲間入|なかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to join the ranks of ~
- {仲間入|なかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve membership in ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to join ~

USAGE:
Often used figuratively to describe reaching a milestone or entering an elite category, not just literal group membership.
- ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り: joining the ranks of developed nations
- ⟦{億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}→億万長者：18272_okumanchouja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り: entering the ranks of billionaires
- ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間入|なかまい}り: becoming an adult (figurative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加入|かにゅう}→加入：11915_kanyuu⟧: joining, enrollment (formal, for organizations/subscriptions)
- ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧: participation (for activities/events)
- ⟦{入会|にゅうかい}→入会：11671_nyuukai⟧: joining a club/association
